rejection.authority-not-delegated: This decision names somebody it acts for, but was not made under a delegation.
rejection.cancellation-reason-required: Stopping an approval needs a reason.
rejection.decision-not-the-assigned-approver: This step was not assigned to you.
rejection.decision-requires-a-person: An approval decision must be made by a named person.
rejection.definition-code-invalid: A workflow code must be lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
rejection.definition-name-required: A workflow needs a name in both English and Arabic.
rejection.definition-retired: This workflow has been retired and takes no new versions.
rejection.definition-subject-type-invalid: The subject type must name a module and a subject, such as recruitment.requisition.
rejection.definition-transition-refused: A workflow cannot move from its current state to that one.
rejection.delegation-names-another-approver: That delegation is for somebody else's step.
rejection.delegation-not-required: You are this step's approver and need no delegation to decide it.
rejection.delegation-subject-required: A delegated decision must name the approver it acts for.
rejection.step-identifiers-mismatched: The steps and their identifiers do not correspond.
rejection.step-not-awaiting-a-decision: This step is not the one awaiting a decision.
rejection.step-not-on-this-instance: That step belongs to a different approval.
rejection.step-name-required: An approval step needs a name in both English and Arabic.
rejection.step-ordinal-invalid: A step's position must be a whole number of one or more.
rejection.subject-type-invalid: The subject type must name a module and a subject.
rejection.version-has-no-steps: A workflow version with no approval steps cannot be published.
rejection.version-not-editable: This version has been published and can no longer be changed.
rejection.version-not-published: Only a published workflow version can start an approval.
rejection.version-number-invalid: A version number must be a whole number of one or more.
rejection.version-step-order-broken: The approval steps must be numbered from one with no gaps and no repeats.
rejection.version-transition-refused: A workflow version cannot move from its current state to that one.
